scientific_integrity: Full all-parameter argument by simplex classification, elementary collapses and attaching-map analysis; finite modular computations supplement rather than prove homotopy; literature equivalence is not conclusively excluded by finite searching.
scientific_limitations: Requires simple finite connected graph with girth at least six and pairwise edge-disjoint six-cycles; only inclusive scale-two graph-metric Rips complexes; no classification for overlapping hexagons.
title: Scale-two Rips complexes of graphs with edge-disjoint hexagons
